text:
ida: Heads-up — onboarding NimbusX finetune landed on staging, 7k token context tests failing on token alignment. Repro: shorter contexts ok. Anyone seen this pattern with merged adapters + int8 quant?

sam: on it, can you paste the prompt + token snapshot? curious if it's a tokenizer shift.

ida: snippet attached below. Not huge, but numeric spans get split differently after merge: ```
User: Please extract invoice number 00012345 and total.
Tokens around numeric span: [321, 1023, 40012, 64, 7, 8, 9] -> after merge: [321, 1023, 400, 12, 64, 7, 8, 9]
```

leo: that looks like a bytepair boundary change. I saw similar when an adapter accidentally flipped vocab_override. Were adapters merged with any tokenizer patches?

ida: Merge used stitcher v0.9 default. Merge flags: `vocab_override=true` (we usually don't set this). We didn't rescale weights.

marta: quick eval pack run (baseline vs merged) coming in: accuracy delta -3.2% on invoice extraction, majority of errors are token boundary shifts for numeric spans. Token alignment error rate ~15x vs baseline. I ran int8 and int4 — int4 worse, but int8 still fails.

ida: command I ran: ```bash
./eval_pack/run_eval --model=redwood/llama-14b --adapter=nimbusx-lora --quant=int8 --ctx=7168 --pack=invoice-extract-small
```

eval-bot: New evaluation run queued: id=eval-1768601240. Status: running. Results will be uploaded to /evals/1768601240.

sam: can we try re-merging with `vocab_override=false` and `rescale=true`? that fixed a similar client case last quarter. If that's a no-go, keep unmerged adapter variant.

leo: I'll run tokenizer alignment diff and remerge with rescale. quick patch: ```python
from tokenizers import Tokenizer
# compare encodings
base = Tokenizer.from_file('base.json')
ad = Tokenizer.from_file('adapter_override.json')
# diff code...
```

marta: FYI NimbusX dataset has a lot of zero-padded invoice IDs and some custom separators (| and —). Adapter may have introduced a special-case token.

ida: Plan: 1) remerge with vocab_override=false + rescale=true 2) run eval_pack (int8 + baseline) 3) if still failing, spin up an unmerged model variant (shadow) for the customer on dedicated capacity and run long-context int16 run.

leo: I can take step 1 and 2. ETA ~45m.

infra-bot: deploy request approved for staging slot `ml-staging-4`. Slot will be ready in ~5m.

ida: thanks. @marta can you queue the pack comparator once leo pushes the new merge? please include the token-diff artifact.

marta: will do. I'll run both `--quant=int8` and `--quant=int16` for comparison and attach CSVs.

sam: note: if we surface this as a product-level fix (stitcher default change), flag ops + docs. Might affect other customer merges.

ida: good point. if rescale fixes it, we should add a guardrail in the merge CI to warn on `vocab_override=true`.

leo: started remerge now. I see a small vocab delta; pushing patch in 5.

marta: queued evals after leo's push. eval IDs: eval-1768601255 (int8), eval-1768601265 (int16).

eval-bot: eval-1768601255 complete. summary: token-boundary-failures reduced by ~70% vs previous merged run. accuracy delta now -0.9%. full logs: /evals/1768601255/logs.csv

ida: excellent progress. if int16 closes the remaining gap we can offer dedicated shadow variant while we roll CI guard.

sam: agreed. thumbs-up from me. :thumbsup:

ida: thanks team — will follow up with a short postmortem and a proposed merge CI check.

leo: filing a small PR to change stitcher defaults + unit test for numeric tokens.

marta: uploading artifacts now.

ida: closing loop for now. feel free to ping if anything else crops up. :wave:
